final: WITH joined AS (SELECT p.death_country AS country FROM batting b JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country <> ''), grp AS (SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM joined GROUP BY country), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM grp), shares AS (SELECT g.country, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM grp g JOIN tot t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), avg_s AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.country, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM shares s JOIN avg_s a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
